The '''Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization''', or '''A.C.L.O.''' for short, was a pro-[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] medical supply organization active on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
[[File:ACLOCommando.jpg|thumb|left|175px|An A.C.L.O. commando.]]
{{Quote|I see here that the A.C.L.O. does a lot of killing and sabotage, even though they claim to be a peaceful political group and medical supply company.|[[Dathnaeya Loessin]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CoA" />}}
The Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization operated out of an [[A.C.L.O. office|office]] on the [[Double Worlds|twin world]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="SWG:II" /> The organization was officially a peaceful political group and medical supply company.<ref name="SWG:CoA" /> However, during the Galactic Civil War between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the Rebel Alliance, the organization was affiliated with the Rebellion and was considered an enemy of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWG:RI" /> In addition to its medical activities, the A.C.L.O. also maintained paramilitary troops, [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] and [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]].<ref name="SWG:II" />

==History==
{{Quote|The A.C.L.O.!!! Those disgusting mynocks! The nerve of them, slicing my computer and framing me. Our reputation with the Empire is too important to let a bunch of trumped up pranksters ruin it with their amateurish slicing tactics.|[[Galiir Ac Yandar]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:II" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization sought to join the Rebel Alliance on a permanent basis.<ref name="SWG:RI" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the A.C.L.O. representative [[Trezya Nenei]] met Rebel [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vayde Quellium]] in [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] to negotiate the integration of the A.C.L.O. in the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SWG:RI" />

[[File:ACLO.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A.C.L.O. staff in the [[A.C.L.O. office]].]]
During the same time, the Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization was in conflict with the [[Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony]], a Talusian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization affiliated with the Empire.<ref name="SWG:RI" /> Similarly to the A.C.L.O., the N.S.H. was also negotiating its integration into the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. However, the negotiations were disturbed when A.C.L.O. slicers planted information that almost ruined the reputation of the N.S.H. commander [[Galiir Ac Yandar]]. Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Braedic Ekirk|Ekirk]] dispatched a spacer to raid the A.C.L.O. office. The Imperial spacer killed [[Leeta Poandeu]], the slicer who was responsible for slicing Yandar's system, and then assisted [[Mark Hieks]], a N.S.H. [[Spy/Legends|covert operative]] infiltrated in the A.C.L.O. office. The spacer also slained A.C.L.O. terrorists who sabotaged Imperial shipments.<ref name="SWG:II" />

In the meantime, N.S.H. troops shut down an A.C.L.O. clinic and imprisoned the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] medical officer [[Syirlabradawk]]. They also confiscated a shipment of medical supplies before its delivery to Rebel forces on Talus. Captain Quellium and Trezya Nenei therefore sent a spacer to the [[N.S.H. base]].<ref name="SWG:RI" /> The spacer was recommended by [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer [[Dathnaeya Loessin]] who wanted to determine what kind of people the Rebellion had chosen to work with.<ref name="SWG:CoA" /> The spacer assaulted the N.S.H. base and managed to retrieve the medical shipment and rescue the medical officer, killing many N.S.H. enforcers in the process. The death of so much N.S.H. mercenaries later allowed the A.C.L.O. to easily ambush an unit of N.S.H. enforcers and stole their shipment of Imperial medical computers.<ref name="SWG:RI" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:II" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The A.C.L.O. was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Crisis of Allegiance|Crisis of Allegiance]]" arc with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
